sections.name: 10270 - Complete.ldr
sections.description: Complete Bookshop diorama - a two-building street scene featuring a tan/turquoise bookshop with dormer windows and a dark-red mansard roof, a neighbouring white/turquoise townhouse with a bay window and balcony, plus an ornamental tree, lampposts, a pendulum clock, bookshelves, and two minifigures.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - First Building.ldr
sections.description: Main bookshop facade - medium-nougat brick walls with green and white windowed fronts, a reddish-brown shingled lower floor, tiled signage panels (incl. BIRCH/BOOKS and 'Once upon a time...'), a green-panelled front door, rail-tile window mullions, and structural technic-brick and plate framing.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Tree Fence.ldr
sections.description: Decorative fence assembly - black clip plates, brackets and handles supporting four black 'sausage' bars, anchored on a reddish-brown technic brick; used as an iron-style railing.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Stair Step.ldr
sections.description: Small brown-and-green step detail - a two-blade technic rotor and round tile forming a tread with green-tile trim.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Bookshelf-1.ldr
sections.description: Wall-mounted bookshelf section - reddish-brown shelf board with side-stud bricks and coloured groove tiles (turquoise, red, orange) representing book spines.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Bookshelf-2.ldr
sections.description: Larger bookshelf unit - reddish-brown shelf plates and tiles with multi-coloured side-stud bricks and groove tiles depicting a row of assorted books.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Entrance_Door_Arch.ldr
sections.description: Curved entrance arch - a white 1x6x2 curved-top arch framed by light-bluish-grey round-ended plates, headlight bricks and tile details over the doorway.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Stair_Pedestal.ldr
sections.description: Green-topped stair pedestal - a 6x10 green plate base with reddish-brown inverted slopes and tiles forming steps, accented by green-tile trim and black telescopes as finials.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Second_Floor.ldr
sections.description: Upper interior floor - light-bluish-grey plate decking for the second storey, with medium-nougat brick walls, arched window openings, fence-lattice railings, seating, cups, and tiled window/door detailing.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Easychair.ldr
sections.description: Black upholstered armchair - curved-top bricks and hinge/bracket plates forming a lounge seat with reddish-brown wooden feet.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Lamp.ldr
sections.description: Standing street lamp - a black handled bar and telescope pole topped by a pearl-gold clip and a clear domed cylinder lamp head.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Pendulum_Clock.ldr
sections.description: Wall-hung pendulum clock - reddish-brown case with a windowed face carrying a clock-face patterned tile, pearl-gold pendulum bob and ornamental slope trim.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Window-1.ldr
sections.description: Multi-pane window assembly - white window frames with clear glass and curved-top detail bricks, topped by a half-round fanlight.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Roof.ldr
sections.description: Dark-red mansard roof - steep double/convex slope bricks forming the dormered roof over the bookshop, with white and turquoise dormer windows, chimneys, ornamental finials (microphones, skeleton legs), and ogee arch detail.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Roof_Deco.ldr
sections.description: Roof cresting detail - hinge-mounted dark-red curved slopes, lime accents and reddish-brown ridge tiles forming ornamental rooftop decoration.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Roof_Rear.ldr
sections.description: Rear mansard roof slope - a field of dark-red 2x2x3 double-convex and solid-stud slope bricks backed by black reinforcement panels and grey plates.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-1_Tree.ldr
sections.description: Autumn ornamental tree - technic pin/axle trunk and branches holding olive-green leaves and bright-light-orange, yellow and orange leaf clusters.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-2_Cellar Deck.ldr
sections.description: Cellar/pavement scene on a green baseplate - tiled cellar hatch, reddish-brown wood decking, flower beds (lime/lavender/blue petals), a white lamppost, a pumpkin, gardening tools and assorted crates and accessories.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-2_Stair.ldr
sections.description: Interior staircase - light-bluish-grey hinge plates with dark-tan tread plates, black wheel-pin and clip details, and a black vine/swirl stem forming a stairway with railing.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-2_Ground_Floor.ldr
sections.description: Townhouse ground-floor interior/exterior - turquoise brick walls with white-trim windows, a medium-azure front door, brown wood flooring, a fireplace with flame, seating, a ship-portrait tile, newspaper-tile detail and various furnishings and accessories.
sections.author: Ulrich Röder [UR]
sections.license: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0 : see CAreadme.txt

sections.name: 10270 - Building-2_First_Floor.ldr
sections.description: Townhouse first-floor room - turquoise and white walls with a dark-blue bay/round-corner feature, dormer and arched windows, a turntable, log-brick fireplace trim, curved bright-light-orange/azure accents, a suspension-bridge portrait tile and fenced gallery detailing.

sections.name: 10270 - Building-2_First_Floor_Balcony.ldr
sections.description: First-floor balcony - turquoise brick railing with dark-blue slopes forming a dormered bay, a white roof-window, brown door and trim, plus small floral accents on a tan/white plate base.
